exposure: blood Phe concentrations (pre-conception and during pregnancy)
cohort: The study included six married patients with phenylketonuria (PKU) in China who became pregnant between 2012 and 2017.
finding: Infant outcomes, including low birth weight and developmental quotients, were related to maternal blood Phe management prior to and during pregnancy.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (< 2500 g) was observed in two offspring, and anthropomorphic measurements were taken.
gest_age: Gestational age was assessed, but specific findings related to it were not detailed in the abstract.
